title: UPSC CSE Prelims 2026 on May 24 - Admit Card Out, Last-Minute Strategy & Exam Day Checklist
author: Ash K.
summary: UPSC Civil Services Preliminary Exam 2026 is on May 24 (Sunday) - 3 days away. Admit cards released May 15 at upsconline.nic.in. GS Paper I (9:30 AM) and CSAT Paper II (2:30 PM). Over 13 lakh candidates expected.
body: The UPSC Civil Services Preliminary Examination 2026 is 3 days away - Sunday, May 24, 2026. If you're appearing, here's your complete exam day preparation guide.

DetailInformation
Exam DateMay 24, 2026 (Sunday)
Paper I (GS)9:30 AM – 11:30 AM (2 hours)
Paper II (CSAT)2:30 PM – 4:30 PM (2 hours)
Total QuestionsPaper I: 100 MCQs | Paper II: 80 MCQs
Total MarksPaper I: 200 | Paper II: 200
Negative Marking1/3 of allotted marks per wrong answer
CSAT Qualifying33% (66 out of 200) - qualifying only
Admit Card ReleasedMay 15, 2026
Download Atupsconline.nic.in / upsc.gov.in
Expected Candidates13+ lakh
Answer KeysVia QPRep portal after exam
Objection WindowUntil May 31, 2026

Admit card - download NOW if you haven't: Visit upsconline.nic.in → Enter registration number or roll number + DOB → Download → Print two copies. Check your name, photo, exam centre address, and reporting time.

What to carry: Printed admit card (2 copies). Original photo ID (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID - same as on admit card). Black ballpoint pen. Transparent water bottle. Analog watch (digital/smart watches banned).
What NOT to carry: Mobile phone, smartwatch, Bluetooth earpiece, calculator, electronic gadgets of any kind. These will be confiscated and may lead to disqualification.

Last 3 days strategy: Do NOT start any new topic. Revise what you know - focus on Polity, Geography, History facts. Read last 6 months of current affairs. Attempt 1 full-length mock today, analyse mistakes. Rest on May 23 - no studying after 6 PM.
Paper I strategy: Attempt 65-75 questions with high accuracy rather than all 100. Each wrong answer costs 0.67 marks. If you can eliminate 2 options, attempt. Otherwise skip.
CSAT strategy: Paper II is qualifying only - you need 33% (66/200). Focus on reading comprehension and basic maths. Don't panic over decision-making questions.
For complete UPSC preparation resources, check our UPSC CSE exam guide. For comparison with other civil services exams, see our exam comparisons.

faqs.question: When is UPSC CSE Prelims 2026?
faqs.answer: May 24, 2026 (Sunday). Paper I (GS) 9:30-11:30 AM. Paper II (CSAT) 2:30-4:30 PM.

faqs.question: Where to download UPSC Prelims 2026 admit card?
faqs.answer: Download from upsconline.nic.in or upsc.gov.in using registration number or roll number and DOB. Released May 15.

faqs.question: Is CSAT qualifying in UPSC Prelims?
faqs.answer: Yes. CSAT (Paper II) is qualifying only - need 33% (66/200). Only Paper I marks count for cutoff.

faqs.question: Is there negative marking in UPSC Prelims?
faqs.answer: Yes. 1/3 of marks allotted per question deducted for each wrong answer.

faqs.question: When will UPSC Prelims answer keys be released?
faqs.answer: UPSC will release provisional answer keys on QPRep portal shortly after exam. Objections until May 31.

faqs.question: Can I carry mobile phone to UPSC Prelims?
faqs.answer: No. All electronic gadgets strictly banned. Carry only admit card, photo ID, pen, water, analog watch.

callout.heading: 3 Days to Prelims
callout.content: Download admit card NOW from upsconline.nic.in. Print 2 copies. Visit exam centre today to check route. Sleep well on May 23 - no studying after 6 PM. Carry black ballpoint pen and original photo ID.
